paper_title: MALADE Orchestration of LLM-powered Agents with Retrieval Augmented   Generation for Pharmacovigilance
caption: Derivation of ADE Scores from Event Probability. The x-axis represents the LLM's output probability estimate, and the color indicates the mapping for the corresponding set of labels.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the derivation of ADE (Adverse Drug Event) scores based on the estimated probability of effect, with the x-axis labeled “Estimated Probability of Effect” and scaled linearly from 0.0 to 1.0, representing the LLM’s output probability estimate. The y-axis is labeled “ADE Score” and is also scaled linearly from 0.0 to 1.0. The plot contains two lines: a green line, labeled “Decreased Risk,” which starts at an ADE Score of 0.5 when the Estimated Probability of Effect is 0.0 and decreases linearly to an ADE Score of 0.0 at an Estimated Probability of Effect of 1.0; and an orange line, labeled “No Effect OR Increased Risk,” which starts at an ADE Score of 0.5 when the Estimated Probability of Effect is 0.0 and increases linearly to an ADE Score of 1.0 at an Estimated Probability of Effect of 1.0. Both lines are solid with no markers, and their color coding corresponds to the mapping for the respective label sets described in the caption.
